_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for matthew-life-platform's replication configuration (DIL-027, #3042).
put-bucket-replication REPLACES the whole configuration — a rule not declared here is
DELETED on the next apply. Change rules HERE, never in the console.
Why this file and not CDK: the primary bucket is imported (Bucket.from_bucket_name in
cdk/stacks/core_stack.py), so CDK cannot attach a replication configuration to it — the
same constraint that puts the bucket policy and the lifecycle configuration in the
out-of-IaC ring (docs/MANAGED_WHERE_LEDGER.md). The DESTINATION bucket and the ROLE are
fully CDK-owned in cdk/stacks/backup_stack.py; only this source-side put is out.
DeleteMarkerReplication is Disabled ON PURPOSE. A delete on the source must not
propagate to the backup — that is the difference between a backup and a mirror. The IAM
half says the same thing: the role has no s3:ReplicateDelete.
Filter/Prefix is raw/ ONLY. Everything outside raw/ is recomputable from raw/.
